messages:
maya: hitting a weird issue in the onboarding sampleapp — duplicate pages + intermittent 429s when prefetch window = 4 and client concurrency = 8. cursor in logs advances but some retries are replaying an old cursor. not sure if this is token refresh-related or our paginator logic.

samir: can you paste the minimal repro or logs? is this only JS sdk or seen in other languages?

maya: only on the JS sampleapp so far. quick log excerpt:

```
INFO fetchPage cursor=abc123 -> items=25
WARN request retry (401) token-refresh start
INFO token refreshed
INFO retrying request cursor=abc123 -> 429
INFO fetchPage cursor=def456 -> items=25
INFO fetchPage cursor=abc123 -> items=25  // duplicate
```

maya: looks like a request that started before token refresh got retried after the cursor advanced and ended up fetching the same page again.

alex: hmm could be the HTTP client retrying after a 401 and re-sending the original request body (which contains an old cursor) without checking if cursor moved. JS http lib might be replaying the exact request object.

nora: sdk parity note: python sdk has a `cursor_guard` option in the paginator that rejects retries if the latest cursor doesn't match expected. JS doesn't expose that yet.

samir: short-term workaround: reduce prefetch window to 1 or add a per-cursor semaphore so only one inflight request per cursor. longer term we should ensure retry handler consults current cursor state before replaying.

maya: tried the semaphore workaround, seems to stop duplicates locally. patch attached to my branch.

samir: can you paste the tiny change? example pattern:

```
const locks = new Map();
async function fetchWithCursor(cursor) {
  if (!locks.has(cursor)) locks.set(cursor, Promise.resolve());
  const prior = locks.get(cursor);
  const token = prior.then(() => actualFetch(cursor));
  locks.set(cursor, token.catch(() => {}));
  return token;
}
```

nora: that works but it's a bit heavy; alternative is to make the SDK retry layer call a provided hook `shouldReplayRequest(oldReq, currentState) -> boolean` and default to true for idempotent calls but false when request.body.cursor != currentState.cursorMap[streamId].

alex: agreed — safer to make SDK opt-in guarded by default for paginators. also add telemetry when a retry is dropped so customers can diagnose.

maya: I'll open a PR proposing `retryGuard` for the paginator and a docs note for onboarding sampleapp recommending window <= concurrency by default.

devex-bot: Created issue #3456: "js-sdk: prefetch window race causes duplicate pages when token refresh/retries occur"

cli-bot: Staging preview for maya/sampleapp available at https://staging.internal.redwood/sampleapp/branch/maya-prefetch-fix

maya: awesome, thanks. i'll include a tiny repro script and exact steps in the issue. pinging @samir for review when i open the PR.

samir: i'll review tomorrow. FYI we should also add an e2e test that simulates 401+retry while cursor advances.

maya: adding that to the issue. thanks :thumbsup:

alex: quick note for release planning — if we default the retryGuard for paginators we should include a minor version bump note in the changelog.

maya: noted. last message: repro added to issue, PR soon.
